title: LoopPolicy
description: One loop's immutable disposition: how proposals are settled, and whether anyone is attending who could answer a question. Workspace capability admission precedes both.

attended.description: Whether an interactive partner exists who can answer. False declares an unattended run: no human-in-the-loop surface is offered, and a wait nobody could end becomes a conclusion. Absent means true, so a policy written before this field keeps its meaning.
